sop_title: Resolving Orders API Disk Full Error
purpose: To resolve the disk full issue on the orders-api service by clearing old temporary files.
when_to_use: Use when the orders-api health check indicates a failing disk or when encountering a No space left on device error.
prerequisites: kubectl access to the shop namespace
curl access to the orders-api service

steps.instruction: Check the disk usage to confirm the problem.
Clear temporary files to free up disk space.
steps.expect: Temporary files older than one day are deleted.

steps.instruction: Check the health status to confirm the fix.

sop_change: Created a new SOP as no internal SOP previously covered this issue.
short_description: Orders API experienced a disk full error due to accumulated temporary PDF receipt files.
problem_statement: The orders-api service failed due to an OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device caused by receipt files filling up the temporary directory.
impact: The orders-api service health became degraded due to disk exhaustion.
trigger: Accumulation of temporary receipt files in the /var/lib/shoplite/tmp directory.
immediate_resolution: Deleted temporary files older than one day using find.
root_causes: Temporary PDF receipt files accumulated in /var/lib/shoplite/tmp and were not automatically cleaned up, eventually exhausting the available disk space.

timeline.event: OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device reported for receipt-8812.pdf.
Engineer asked about safety of step 2.
Engineer completed the steps and resolved the incident.

action_items: Implement an automated cleanup job for temporary files older than one day in /var/lib/shoplite/tmp.
